posts.title: Messages to the Cat 给校猫的留言

op.content:
This is a permanent place to leave me a message. Feedback, suggestions, complaints, questions, or just a quick word, all of it belongs here.

- I check in regularly, but I can't guarantee a reply to every message.
- As long as it follows the server rules, say it however you like.
- This thread will not be closed.

这里是一个长期开放的留言处。想对我说的话，意见、建议、吐槽、问题，或者只是想聊一句，都可以放在这里。

- 我会定期检查，但无法保证能够回复每一条。
- 在遵守版规的前提下，怎么说都可以。
- 这个帖子不会关闭。

I'll mark the ones I've already answered with <:gamekey:1448943277117145140>
已经回答过的内容，我会标记 <:gamekey:1448943277117145140>
Repeat questions I've already answered elsewhere, or anything that doesn't seem to need a reply, I'll skip.
已经在别处回答过的重复问题，或者看起来不需要回复的内容，我会跳过。
Unfriendly comments aimed at other Keepers will be handled by the moderators under the server rules. Whatever you post here, address it to me.
对其他守密人不友善的评论，版主会按版规处理。这个帖子里的话，请都说给我。

messages.content:
无论哪个版本，都是我们辛苦设计的结果。很感谢有守密人更喜欢早期的设计。不管哪一边，我们想创造的都是「易于上手、难于精通」的体验，也一直在努力维护和创造那种真正有效的决策差异。

但国际服的平衡设计，你看到的可以说是千疮百孔。原因在于，当时我们没有看到这个游戏未来会怎样扩展和变化，于是不断修改，补上了两三屏都看不完的补充平衡规则。每一次平衡失衡，都会把许多原本细心打磨过的体验破坏掉。回头看，国际服早期的设计里有相当多的矛盾：有些选择看起来存在，其实是假的；有些效果噪音很多，花了很多精力去理解，玩下来却没有实际作用。

日服的设计更保守，但仍然建立在同样的「意义感」上。比如熔毁·朵尔的「缸中之脑」能力，就是国际服里我们没来得及深挖的主题；杜勒赛因我们也会融入「吞噬即获得记忆」的主题。效果保守的好处是，像星辰篇就几乎没有负面限制类的平衡规则，精力可以聚焦在那些真正有意义的选择上。

我们会吸取两边实践的经验，让各自的设计继续进化。

Whichever version it is, both are the result of hard design work. I'm grateful that some Keepers prefer the earlier design. On either side, what we want to create is an experience that's easy to pick up but hard to master, and we've kept working to preserve and create decisions that genuinely matter.

But the balance design of the global server, as you've seen, is riddled with holes. The reason is that back then we couldn't see how the game would expand and change, so we kept patching it, adding supplementary balance rules that run two or three screens long. Every time the balance broke, it destroyed a lot of carefully polished experiences along with it. Looking back, the early global design had plenty of contradictions: some choices only looked like choices, and some effects were so noisy that they took real effort to understand yet made little actual difference in play.

The JP design is more conservative, but it's built on the same sense of meaning. Doll: Inferno's "Brain in a Vat" ability, for instance, is a theme we never had the chance to dig into on global; and for Doresain we'll be weaving in the theme of "devour to gain memories." The upside of conservative effects is that Astral Reign, for example, has almost no negative-restriction balance rules, so the attention can go to the choices that genuinely matter.

We'll take the lessons from both runs and let each design keep evolving.

messages.content:
我们确实在过去的团队和产能危机里，长期真实环境下的游玩不足，只在内部完成设计、测试，然后更新。今年人手扩张了，但也只能保证更稳定的更新。所以很多时候，我们需要社区来帮我们校准方向。

这里的矛盾在于：这套系统的数值和规则复杂到，只有最初的核心战斗设计师和我两个人合起来才能较好地维护，而我们两个又是最忙、长期加班的人。这不是找理由，是把真实发生的事告诉大家。我们也很讨厌「不玩自己游戏」的人，我们研发时每个版本的游玩和讨论比很多人想象的多得多，但长期环境下的验证这一块，未来确实应该补上。

It's true that during our past crises of staffing and capacity, we didn't play enough in the real, long-term environment; we designed and tested internally, then shipped. We've expanded the team this year, but that only guarantees more stable updates. So in many cases, we rely on the community to help us calibrate our direction.

The tension here is that the numbers and rules of this system are complex enough that only the original core combat designer and I, working together, can maintain them well, and the two of us are also the busiest, longest-overtime people on the team. That isn't an excuse; it's simply what has actually been happening. We dislike "developers who don't play their own game" as much as you do, and the amount we play and discuss each version during development is far more than many imagine, but validation in the long-term environment is genuinely something we need to fill in going forward.

messages.content:
这里有一个结构性的原因：大家的作战实力、护盾和回复能力会随着强度提高而提高，但血量上限和护盾上限不会。于是，一个「合理的挑战」里，敌人的伤害相对于血量会越来越高。这很反直觉，但数学上是成立的。即便在这么严苛的情况下，有些生存向队伍配合回血能力，仍然能活到四五十回合和敌人打持久战。

如果不这么严苛，挑战感就不强，比较随便就能堆够生存。

这是游戏后期环境在数学结构上的问题，我们需要小心地寻找办法。

There's a structural reason behind this: your combat power, Shield, and healing all scale up as strength increases, but the HP cap and Shield cap do not. So in any "reasonable challenge," enemy damage relative to your HP keeps climbing. It's counterintuitive, but the math holds. Even under conditions this harsh, some survival-oriented teams with healing can still last forty or fifty turns in a war of attrition against the enemy.

If it weren't this harsh, there'd be little sense of challenge; survivability would be easy to stack without much thought.

This is a mathematical, structural issue in the game's late-game environment, and we need to look for solutions carefully.

messages.prev:
"developers who don't play their own game" is not what i was saying,
the game is intrinsically fun and balanced when progression matches difficulty and the time-limited extrinsic rewards are out of equation, which is what i assume to be the reason for the disconnect between developers and players...
in morimens it's difficult to know when progression matches difficulty - different lineups can have vastly different investment, and it became harder to compare them to others via replays now because there's no way to filter by investment level, or clears that rely on ecogs...
and as soon as you add extrinsic rewards, the fear of missing out spirals into optimizing the fun out of the game, it's hard to settle even for slightly lower rewards when all you have to do is try a bit harder and use an ecog, even if it sucks out all the fun out of the game.
and the d-zone difficulty ramps up in steps steep enough that even if one tier feels too easy, the next tier can be difficult enough that it stops being fun.
